product_one_liner.value: Reveal provides AI-powered eDiscovery software for legal departments, law firms, legal service providers, government and education teams, covering discovery, investigations, litigation, legal holds, early case assessment and analytics.

pricing_page.notes: The site directs prospects to request a demo rather than publishing a pricing page with plans.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear in Reveal Data's Trust Center list of organizations that reviewed and trusted Reveal Data.

employee_band.notes: The cited company profile reports 478 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index is an eDiscovery and legal-AI insights/marketing blog; it does not show at least two engineer-authored build/architecture posts.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains numerous product areas and articles, including processing, review, AI, generative AI, production, workflows and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open positions page lists Support Analyst, Manager Strategy & Transformation, Collections Specialist, Sr. Software Engineer, Account Executive roles and Strategic Sales Engineer, but no AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM or computer-vision title.

model_provider.notes: Public product, documentation, blog and trust materials reviewed did not clearly state which underlying AI model provider Reveal uses.

last_funding.notes: The funding database identifies the latest round as Growth Equity for $200M on January 26, 2021; Reveal's announcement describes it as more than $200M.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round was January 2021, outside the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers board lists Account Executive, II and Accounts Executive I; the cited posting describes Account Executive I responsibilities.

launched_6mo.notes: Reveal published an October 2026 product update and announced Reveal AI on August 24, 2026, both within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On October 14, 2025, Reveal announced that founder and CEO Wendell Jisa became board chairman and Eric Harmon became CEO.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Account Executive posting names Salesforce CRM and lists ZoomInfo, Groove and Gong among preferred sales tools.
